title: Mind Oasis: A Mental Health Application
summary: A student capstone full-stack mental health app (React frontend, Express backend) with a separate Python RAG chatbot assistant. Its ai/dataset.py script uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality to generate and validate synthetic mental-health data.
evidence: ai/dataset.py: CTGANSynthesizer(self.metadata, epochs=epochs, verbose=True, cuda=False) trained via train_synthesizer()
needs: could not confirm dataset.py is actually invoked by the running app (agent.py/server.py) vs standalone script
